content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

'Property entails commitment' is one of the tenets of our social order. Everyone should be able to get the utmost profit from his or her property. A fixing of rent prices according to the market alone, however, will lead to a further division of society. The rich and poor live in different neighbourhoods. A constant increase in rent upon a change of tenants hence cannot be desired by society.
What argument components exists in sentence " The rich and poor live in different neighbourhoods" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>The rich and poor live in different neighbourhoods</pro>
